about: Conformance cases for card format 1.0 (Cards-Format.md). Each library is a folder below the fixture root, with every folder inside it; a library is laid out by its index.card, or by the defaults when it has none (the root has none). Files are given with the size Get File Name List reports, so a card store can be tested without the media; a file not listed is missing.
